anomalies.description: Two players engage in a physical fight on the ice: one in white jersey and helmet grapples with another in grey top and helmet, exchanging holds, shoves, and attempts to take down the opponent; sticks are held but not used as weapons.; A third individual (in dark jacket) intervenes, physically separating the two fighters; the struggle continues briefly as the original two resist separation, involving mutual grappling and pushing during the break-up attempt.

After being taken down, the player in white is on the ice while the player in grey continues to press down and control him, appearing to strike or push his head/upper body while he is unable to effectively defend himself.
Two individuals in hockey gear engage in a sustained physical fight on the ice, involving grappling, punching, and one player being taken down to the ice.
Two ice hockey players engage in a prolonged physical fight on the ice, involving grappling, shoving, and attempted takedowns; both are actively resisting and participating throughout the sequence.

Two players in hockey gear engage in a physical fight on the ice, grappling and attempting to throw punches while holding sticks; a third player (coach/staff) intervenes starting around 24.0s.; Two players engage in a physical altercation on the ice: one in a grey sweatshirt and white helmet is grabbed and pushed by another player in dark clothing and a cap, while a third player in white is being held or restrained. The interaction involves grappling, pushing, and close physical contact consistent with mutual combat.

After the initial fight is broken up by a third person, the player in white remains on the ice in a vulnerable position while the player in gray continues to hold/press down on him, with the intervener struggling to fully separate them; this constitutes continued aggression toward a less-able-to-defend opponent.; After the initial fight subsides, the player in the dark jacket (likely a coach) appears to push or shove the player in white (who is bent over and seemingly off-balance), while the grey-sweatshirt player steps back. The white-jerseyed player is in a vulnerable posture, suggesting a potential act of abuse rather than mutual combat.

Two individuals in dark and white jerseys are engaged in a physical altercation, with one person in a dark jacket restraining or grappling the other who is wearing a white helmet and jersey; their bodies are tightly interlocked and moving together across the ice.

The physical confrontation continues as additional players and staff intervene; multiple people surround the two central figures, with hands on shoulders and attempts to separate them, indicating ongoing mutual combat being broken up.

The altercation is still unresolved; the two main individuals remain in close contact while others continue to intervene, with visible pushing and holding actions suggesting residual physical conflict before full separation.
